nom: Clinique Clarifying Face Lotion Toner 2 - Dry Combination

avis.texte: Sadly, this toner dried my skin out and irritated it. It was the only thing I had changed in my routine, so I could pinpoint it as the irritant. It dried out the skin underneath my eyebrows terribly and made that area flake. It also irritated the area around my mouth, making it slightly red and a little raw-feeling. Once I stopped use, I had to use Vaseline on these areas twice a day for about 6 weeks to clear it up. I couldn't figure out how to get rid of it and didn't want to toss a 6.7 oz bottle, so I ended up using it as a post-shave treatment for my legs before moisturizing. It seemed fine for that 😂 My skin is only slightly dry/pretty normal, so I wouldn't use this if you share that skin type.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I have been using this tonic for several weeks and it has worked incredibly well for me. I have combination/dry skin and many times the toners leave my skin tight or irritated, but this one does not. It leaves the skin soft, clean and with a fresh, undrying feeling. I've noticed that it helps improve texture and prevent breakouts, especially in the T-zone. The best thing is that it absorbs quickly and prepares the skin very well for the rest of the routine. If you're sensitive, I recommend using it once a day and applying moisturizer afterwards. Overall, it's an effective, smooth product and worth what it costs. I would definitely buy it again.

avis.texte: Redness, sensitivity, or new dark spots? I used this toner daily for years, not realizing the alcohol and astringents were damaging my skin barrier. Overuse can cause irritation and pigmentation. Switch to gentle, hydrating formulas instead.

I started noticing spots on my skin recently that I'm guessing I had overlooked so I started using the clarifying lotion again and within a couple of weeks I started seeing a HUGE difference and I'm also seeing a great difference around my neck. As a teenager, I relied on Clinique's 3-Step regimen, especially the Clarifying Lotion 2, to prevent breakouts. Being allergic to salicylic acid, it was one of the few toners that worked for me. It gently exfoliates and refreshes my skin, leaving it smooth and clear without irritation. It's become a key part of my routine again, and I'm pleased with the results. Highly recommended for anyone needing a gentle and effective toner.
